note: Tool care and smithing variants (catalog Phase 2c, master s2.2, s2.7 items 5-6, s2.9, s4 items 1, 2, 15, 16; read by src/shared/smithing_rules.gd on server and client). Every number here is s5 tuning for playtest. Durability: a tool breaks at its current maximum (the instance's max_d, else items.json durability); a row with no repair is disposable and is gone at zero; a metal tool stays broken in its slot until repaired at its repair_station with its repair materials, which sets its wear to 0 (its maximum is unchanged). Sharpness (rows with edge: true): each use adds its wear to the instance's sharp; it is fully dull at dull_share of the row durability (more for Tempered and craftsmanship: dull_slower); a fully dull tool wears dull_wear_mult times as fast. Sharpening (R on a dull edge tool, then the other dull edge tools one after another) restores sharpness to 100 % and lowers max_d by sharpen_cost of the row durability for a full sharpening, in proportion to what it restored; a whetstone needs a sound whetstone in the pack and water at hand (a filled water container in the pack, or drinkable water within the thirst reach), takes full_s for a fully dull tool (less in proportion), seat_speed times faster sitting on a seat, and stops when the player walks move_m away or the water or whetstone goes; the grindstone (station grindstone) needs no water and is faster. Variants: craftsmanship +1/+2 only at a Master smithy that serves the recipe, Tempered only for steel rows at a Smithy or Master smithy with temper_addon beside it; eligible rows are single unstackable items of the eligible kinds (no ammunition, materials or food); max_d is set once at craft: durability x (1 + temper durability + craft level x craft durability), the bonuses add, never multiply.
